notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! After the first public version I read a lot of your feedback and watched playthroughs. Based on that, I’ve significantly reworked the demo.



What’s new:

New level. Designed to better communicate what the game is about.

Run button + fewer dialogs. Spend less time walking and reading, more time solving.

Reworked visual style. Updated palette, contrast, and lighting with color-theory in mind.



Hope you enjoy the update!
